standards.title: Domestic Gas Cooking Appliances for Use with Liquefied Petroleum Gases
standards.description: Specifies construction, operation and safety requirements for domestic gas cooking appliances burning liquefied petroleum gases at a supply pressure of 2.94 kPa (30 gf/cm²). Covers table-top gas stoves, built-in hobs, and cooking ranges.
requirements: Gas soundness and leakage prevention at rated working pressure
Thermal efficiency (minimum 68% for domestic burners)
Combustion characteristics (CO/CO2 ratio not exceeding 0.02)
Surface temperature limits on control knobs and body parts
Flame stability, flash back and flame lift resistance
Durability of pan supports and mechanical stability
standards.qco_order: Domestic Gas Stoves for Use with LPG (Quality Control) Order, 2019 (Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas)
testing_parameters: Gas soundness test (0.07 bar pneumatic test)
Thermal efficiency test per burner
Carbon monoxide emission / combustion test
Pan support strength and deflection test
Burner flame ignition and stability test

standards.title: Audio/Video, Information and Communication Technology Equipment – Part 1 Safety Requirements
standards.description: Safety standard applicable to audio, video, information and communication technology equipment. Replaces IS 13252 (Part 1): 2010. Mandatory under BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) for laptops, tablets and computers.
requirements: Protection against electric shock (energy source classification ES1, ES2, ES3)
Electrically-caused fire safety and thermal limits (PS1, PS2, PS3)
Protection against hazardous substances and battery combustion/short-circuit
Mechanically-caused injury protection and enclosure strength
Thermal burn injury prevention on touchable exterior surfaces
Radiation and acoustic energy safety (laser, audio, optical emissions)
standards.qco_order: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirement for Compulsory Registration) Order, MeitY
testing_parameters: Input current and power rating test
Dielectric voltage withstand test
Lithium-ion battery charging and short-circuit test per IS 16046
Drop test and mechanical impact test on outer enclosure
Touch temperature and thermal dissipation test under full load

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – Part 2 Particular Requirements – Section 15 Appliances for Heating Liquids
standards.description: Covers safety requirements for electric kettles, cordless water kettles, electric lunch boxes, milk boilers and similar liquid-heating household appliances having a rated capacity not exceeding 10 litres.
requirements: Protection against electric shock during pouring and cleaning
Boil-dry thermal cutoff protection and automatic steam switch
Heating element insulation resistance and high-voltage withstand
Spillage protection and overflow water drain safety
Cordless base electrical contact safety and interlock mechanism
Thermal endurance and maximum temperature rise on handle
standards.qco_order: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Input power verification and heating rate
Electric strength at 1250V AC test
Boil-dry endurance cycling test (100 cycles)
Moisture resistance and water spillage test
Handle temperature rise test under boiling conditions

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – Part 2 Particular Requirements – Section 3 Electric Irons
standards.description: Covers safety and operational requirements for electric dry irons and steam irons for domestic use, including temperature regulation and soleplate safety.
requirements: Thermostat temperature calibration and thermal fuse cutout
Electrical insulation and leakage current limits (max 0.75 mA)
Thermal endurance of soleplate and soleplate drop test
Steam chamber pressure relief and water leakage protection
Flexible cord strain relief, cord guard flexing durability
Stability and resistance to tipping on heel rest
standards.qco_order: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Thermostat cycling test (1000 operational cycles)
Cord anchorage and 20,000 cycle flexing test
Electric insulation strength test at operating temperature
Steam spray and pressure containment test
Drop test on soleplate from 100mm height

standards.title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
standards.description: Covers requirements and test methods for single-core and multi-core PVC insulated copper/aluminium electrical cables and wires for working voltages up to 1100 V AC.
requirements: Conductor DC electrical resistance limits per km at 20°C
Insulation thickness and outer sheath dimensions
Tensile strength and elongation at break of insulation before and after aging
High voltage spark test in water (3 kV AC for 5 minutes)
Flame retardant properties and thermal heat shock resistance
Cold bend and cold impact resistance at sub-zero temperatures
standards.qco_order: Wires and Cables (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Conductor resistance measurement via Kelvin double bridge
Insulation spark testing at extrusion line
High voltage withstand test (3000 V AC)
Oxygen index and flammability test per IS 10810
Thermal stability test at 200°C

standards.title: Protective Helmets for Motorcycle Riders – Specification
standards.description: Specifies protective requirements, impact attenuation, retention system strength and visor optical requirements for motorcycle helmets intended for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles on Indian roads.
requirements: Impact absorption test at ambient, hot (50°C), cold (-10°C) and water immersion conditions
Retention system (chin strap) dynamic elongation and slippage limits
Rigidity and lateral deformation resistance
Visor optical transmission, light dispersion, and scratch/shatter resistance
Peripheral vision field of view (minimum 105° horizontal and 30° upward)
Audibility and non-interference with sound perception
standards.qco_order: Helmet for Two-Wheeler Riders (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (MoRTH)
testing_parameters: Impact attenuation drop test with monorail/free-fall drop rig
Retention system dynamic test with 10 kg drop mass
Visor luminous transmittance spectrophotometer test
Chin strap quick release button release force test
Shell penetration resistance test with conical striker

standards.title: Domestic Pressure Cookers – Specification
standards.description: Specifies design, material, construction and safety requirements for domestic pressure cookers made of aluminium alloys or stainless steel having capacity between 1 litre and 20 litres.
requirements: Operating pressure regulation between 98 kPa and 137 kPa (1.0 to 1.4 kgf/cm²)
Safety relief valve secondary release pressure (must release before 275 kPa)
Fusible plug or gasket release system for overpressure blowout safety
Proof pressure hydrostatic burst test without leakage or permanent distortion
Handle strength and thermal insulation under full boiling weight
Food grade contact material compliance (non-toxic non-corrosive)
standards.qco_order: Domestic Pressure Cookers (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Hydrostatic pressure test at 2.5 times operating pressure (300 kPa)
Pressure regulator weight accuracy and venting test
Safety valve blowout pressure test
Handle torque and drop test under full load
Material chemical composition analysis via optical emission spectrometer

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – Part 2 Particular Requirements – Section 9 Electric Toasters, Grills, Roasters and Similar Appliances
standards.description: Applies to electric toasters, air fryers, sandwich makers, waffle irons, electric raclettes and tabletop barbecue grills for household use.
requirements: Heating element enclosure and protection against contact with live parts
Thermal cut-out operation under forced fan failure / abnormal use
Outer body touch temperature limits on plastic and metal panels
High temperature food basket and crumb tray non-combustibility
High voltage insulation resistance under maximum hot operating state
Timer and thermostat precision for fire hazard prevention
standards.qco_order: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Temperature rise measurement at 240V under continuous air frying cycle
High voltage dielectric test at 1250V AC
Abnormal operation with stalled circulation fan motor
Earth continuity and leakage current test (< 0.75 mA)
Mechanical stability on a 15-degree inclined surface

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – Part 2 Particular Requirements – Section 6 Cooking Ranges, Hobs, Ovens and Similar Appliances
standards.description: Covers safety requirements for household electric cooking ranges, hobs, induction cooktops, tabletop induction heating plates, and built-in electric ovens.
requirements: Electromagnetic coil insulation and magnetic field shielding
Ceramic glass plate mechanical shock and thermal shock resistance (liquid spill)
Pan detection sensor safety (no heating without ferromagnetic pan)
Overheating protection on IGBT heat sink and glass surface
Protection against water and oil ingress into cooling vents
Leakage current and high-voltage dielectric breakdown resistance
standards.qco_order: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Glass thermal shock test (pouring cold water on 200°C glass top)
Impact test with 500g steel ball dropped from 200mm onto ceramic cooktop
Dielectric test at 1500V AC across power circuit and coil insulation
Thermal rise on IGBT and internal electronics under continuous maximum power
Spillage test with 500ml boiling liquid

standards.title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to and Including 250 Volts and Rated Current up to and Including 16 Amperes – Specification
standards.product: plug and socket outlet smart extension board
standards.description: Covers plugs, fixed socket-outlets, portable socket-outlets, multi-plug adapters and extension cords for AC domestic electrical distribution up to 250 V, 6A and 16A.
requirements: Contact dimension tolerances and non-interchangeability of ratings
Safety shutters on live and neutral socket apertures to prevent child probe insertion
Earthing pin lead and making-before-breaking earthing contact
Terminal temperature rise (< 45°C rise at rated 6A/16A current)
Insulating material glow-wire flammability test at 850°C
Retention force test on plug pins after 10,000 insertion cycles
standards.qco_order: Plugs and Socket-Outlets (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Glow wire ignition test at 850°C on shutter and socket faceplate
Temperature rise test at 1.25 times rated current
Withdrawal force test with calibrated gauges
Electric strength test at 2000V AC for 1 minute
Mechanical endurance test (10,000 insertions at 30 strokes/minute)

standards.title: Switches for Domestic and Similar Purposes – Specification
standards.description: Covers manually operated general purpose switches for AC circuits only, with rated voltage not exceeding 440 V and rated current up to 63 A.
requirements: Normal operation electrical and mechanical endurance (40,000 operations)
Contact separation gap and breaking capacity under inductive/fluorescent lamp load
Temperature rise at terminals not exceeding 45°C during continuous rated current
Clearance and creepage distances between live parts and accessible surfaces
Resistance to abnormal heat, fire and tracking (glow wire 850°C)
Protection against electric shock during installation and operation
standards.qco_order: Switches for Domestic and Similar Purposes (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: 40,000 cycle endurance test with full rated current at 250V AC
Fluorescent lamp load test with inrush current surge
Electric strength test at 2000 V AC
Terminal pull test and torque test on screws
Glow-wire test at 850°C on switch body

standards.title: Electric Ceiling Type Fans and Regulators – Specification
standards.description: Specifies design, performance, air delivery, energy efficiency and safety requirements for AC and BLDC ceiling fans and their electronic/stepped speed regulators.
requirements: Air delivery minimum limits (e.g. 210 m³/min for 1200 mm sweep)
Service value (energy efficiency ratio: air delivery / power input)
Motor winding insulation temperature rise and thermal protection
Blade balance, downrod suspension mechanical shear pin safety
Dielectric test at 1500V AC and earthing continuity
Starting voltage down to 85% of rated 230V mains
standards.qco_order: Ceiling Fans (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT) & BEE Star Labelling
testing_parameters: Air delivery test in standard anemometer test chamber
Service value calculation (m³/min per Watt)
Suspension drop and mechanical tensile test on fan shackle/downrod
Motor winding temperature rise test by resistance method
Blade angle and balance alignment test

standards.title: Table Type Electric Fans and Regulators – Specification
standards.description: Covers portable table fans, desk fans, bracket fans and pedestal fans driven by single-phase AC or DC/BLDC motors.
requirements: Finger guard mesh safety to prevent contact with rotating blades
Mechanical stability against toppling on a 10-degree incline
Air delivery output and oscillation angle mechanism durability
Motor temperature rise and high-voltage dielectric insulation
Cord anchorage and strain relief for flexible supply cable
Motor stall protection without fire hazard
standards.qco_order: BIS Voluntary Standard (General Safety under Electrical Appliances QCO applies)
testing_parameters: Standard test probe finger insertion test through blade guard
Tilt test on 10-degree test plane
Air delivery test via calibrated vane anemometers
Winding temperature rise test under locked rotor conditions
Insulation resistance test before and after humidity conditioning

standards.title: Domestic Electric Food Mixers (Liquidizers and Grinders) and Centrifugal Juicers – Specification
standards.description: Covers domestic electric food mixers, blenders, wet and dry grinders, liquidizers and juicers driven by universal or induction motors up to 1000 W.
requirements: Overload thermal circuit breaker trip protection under jammed rotor
Blade coupling interlock safety (no exposed blade rotation without jar lid)
Liquid spillage protection into motor housing during liquidizer processing
Motor insulation withstand voltage and leakage current limits
Mechanical balance and vibration stability on smooth countertop
Jar coupler shear pin safety and blade retention integrity
standards.qco_order: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Locked rotor endurance and thermal overload trip test
Liquid ingress test by pouring 200ml saline liquid over drive coupling
Dielectric test at 1500 V AC across live terminals and motor frame
Noise level and vibration amplitude measurement
Continuous 30-minute grinding temperature rise test

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – Part 2 Particular Requirements – Section 25 Microwave Ovens
standards.description: Covers the safety of microwave ovens for household use, including combination microwave ovens with resistance heating elements.
requirements: Microwave radiation leakage limit (maximum 50 W/m² or 5 mW/cm² at 50mm)
Door interlock system safety (minimum two independent interlocks to cut magnetron)
Door seal durability and protection against opening during active emission
High voltage capacitor grounding and discharge safety on cover removal
Thermal protection against empty cavity heating and fire containment
Glass turntable thermal durability and mechanical strength
standards.qco_order: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Microwave leakage survey with calibrated electromagnetic field probe
Door interlock cycling test (100,000 door open/close operations)
High-voltage transformer isolation test at 3000 V AC
Empty cavity abnormal operation test for 30 minutes
Enclosure flame resistance and containment test

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – Part 2 Particular Requirements – Section 30 Room Heaters
standards.description: Covers safety requirements for electric room heaters, radiant heaters, convector heaters, fan heaters and oil-filled radiator heaters intended for household heating.
requirements: Protection against touching glowing heating elements (finger probe safety guard)
Tip-over automatic shut-off safety switch when tilted past 15 degrees
Thermal cut-out operation under covered/draped towel abnormal condition
Fire hazard prevention and non-combustibility of outer plastic casing
Oil container hermetic seal integrity on oil-filled radiators (no burst/leak)
Insulation resistance at high operating temperatures
standards.qco_order: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Drape test with felt cloth covering heater for 4 hours to verify cut-out
Tip-over angle test on tilting table
High voltage withstand test at 1250 V AC
Guard mechanical strength test with 100 N force applicator
Surface temperature rise on controls and handle

standards.title: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters – Specification
standards.description: Specifies requirements for stationary storage type electric water heaters intended for domestic use, operating at pressures up to 1 MPa (10 bar).
requirements: Inner tank hydrostatic proof pressure test (2 times rated pressure, min 1.6 MPa)
Dual safety control: adjustable thermostat plus independent non-self-resetting thermal cut-out
Pressure relief safety valve (PRV) and vacuum relief valve operation
Standing loss / standing energy consumption compliance for BEE 5-star rating
Corrosion resistance: vitreous enamel coating or sacrificial magnesium anode
Earthing terminal and high-voltage dielectric insulation (1500 V AC)
standards.qco_order: Electric Water Heaters (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Hydrostatic pressure burst test at 2.4 MPa
Standing energy loss test per 24 hours per IS 2082 clause 13
Thermal cut-out trip temperature verification (< 95°C)
Pressure relief valve discharge rate test
High voltage dielectric test at 1500 V AC

standards.title: Electric Immersion Water Heaters – Specification
standards.description: Covers portable electric immersion heaters designed for heating water in domestic vessels and buckets.
requirements: Terminal head water-tightness and moisture resistance (IPX7 below waterline)
Clear minimum and maximum immersion depth markings
Heating element sheath corrosion resistance (copper chrome plated / incoloy)
Thermal safety protector to prevent boiling dry or fire in plastic bucket
Insulation resistance (> 2 Megaohms) after 24-hour water immersion
Earth continuity from plug pin to metal outer sheath (< 0.1 ohm)
standards.qco_order: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Total water immersion test of terminal head and handle
Dry boiling endurance test on plastic bucket without bucket ignition
Dielectric strength test at 1250 V AC in water
Earth bonding impedance measurement
Leakage current test (< 0.75 mA)

standards.title: Luminaires – Part 5 Particular Requirements – Section 8 Luminaires for Emergency Lighting
standards.description: Covers self-contained emergency lighting luminaires, rechargeable lanterns, emergency exit lights and backup LED lights containing internal secondary batteries.
requirements: Automatic switch-over to emergency battery power upon mains AC supply failure (< 0.5 sec)
Emergency operation duration (minimum 1 to 3 hours rated lumen output)
Battery overcharge, deep discharge and thermal runaway safety per IS 16046
Enclosure flame resistance and battery compartment venting
Luminous flux distribution during emergency mode
High voltage isolation between AC mains and low voltage battery circuit
standards.scheme: Scheme I & Scheme II (CRS for LED / Battery)
standards.qco_order: Lighting Products (Quality Control) Order & MeitY CRS
testing_parameters: Mains failure transfer time test with digital oscilloscope
Duration test: measurement of lumen output after 3 hours
Battery protection circuit test against short circuit and reverse polarity
Dielectric test at 1500 V AC between AC terminals and touchable enclosure
Glow wire test at 750°C on lantern housing

standards.title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes – Safety Requirements for Portable Sealed Secondary Cells – Part 2 Lithium Systems
standards.description: Covers safety requirements and test procedures for portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries (including power banks and battery packs) used in consumer electronics.
requirements: Continuous charging under constant voltage conditions without fire or explosion
External short-circuit test at 55°C ambient temperature
Free fall / drop test onto concrete floor from 1.0 m height
Thermal abuse test at 130°C in circulating air oven
Crush test and impact test simulating mechanical deformation
Overcharging protection: battery management system (BMS) shutdown
standards.qco_order: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Compulsory Registration) Order, MeitY
testing_parameters: External short-circuit test with external resistance < 80 mOhm at 55°C
Overcharge test at 2x rated maximum charging current
Thermal abuse test: chamber ramp to 130°C for 30 minutes
Drop test from 1.0 metre onto concrete surface (3 drops per cell)
Mechanical crush test with 13 kN hydraulic press

standards.title: Solar Flat Plate Collector – Specification
standards.product: solar water heater flat plate collector
standards.description: Specifies requirements, performance criteria, thermal efficiency and materials for liquid heating flat plate solar collectors used in domestic and commercial solar water heaters.
requirements: Absorber plate selective coating solar absorptance (> 0.92) and emittance (< 0.20)
Toughened glass cover solar transmittance (> 85%) and impact strength
Hydrostatic pressure test on absorber copper header and riser tubes (min 1.0 MPa)
Thermal performance and instantaneous efficiency curve determination
Stagnation and thermal shock resistance under dry no-flow full solar irradiance
Corrosion resistance and hermetic weather-tight sealing of aluminium casing
standards.qco_order: Solar Thermal Systems and Collectors (Quality Control) Order (MNRE)
testing_parameters: Outdoor thermal performance efficiency test on dual-axis solar test bench
Pressure test at 10 bar (1.0 MPa) for 30 minutes with zero pressure drop
High-temperature dry stagnation exposure test under 1000 W/m² irradiance
External and internal thermal shock test with cold water flush
Rain penetration spray test on collector box

standards.title: Solar Cooker – Box Type – Specification
standards.description: Specifies design, materials, thermal performance figures of merit (F1 and F2) and fabrication requirements for domestic box-type solar cookers and food warming units.
requirements: First figure of merit F1 (stagnation temperature ratio) not less than 0.12
Second figure of merit F2 (sensible heat transfer cooking power) not less than 0.40
Double glazed low-iron tempered glass cover with silicone gasket seal
Reflector mirror solar specular reflectivity (> 80%)
Cooking pots anodized aluminium or stainless steel with food-safe non-toxic black coating
Casing insulation thermal conductivity (rockwool / glass wool) to prevent heat loss
standards.qco_order: MNRE Recognized Technical Standard for Solar Thermal Cooking Systems
testing_parameters: Stagnation temperature test under clear noon sunlight (> 750 W/m²)
Water boiling sensible heating test to calculate F2 parameter
Mirror specular reflectance measurement via spectrophotometer
Cooking pot non-stick / black coating adhesion and scratch test

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – Part 2 Particular Requirements – Section 85 Fabric Steamers
standards.description: Covers safety requirements for electric fabric steamers, portable handheld garment steamers and commercial upright garment steamers intended for smoothing fabrics by steam.
requirements: Steam boiler pressure relief and overpressure blowout safety
Protection against scalding hot water droplet spitting during operation
Thermal cut-out and dry-run safety when water reservoir empties
Handle touch temperature and thermal insulation barrier
High voltage dielectric withstand between heating element and steam nozzle
Cord anchorage and flexible cord bending endurance
standards.qco_order: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Continuous steam pressure and temperature monitoring test
Dry-run boil-off test for 1 hour without thermal damage
Electric strength test at 1250 V AC
Drop test of handheld steamer unit from 1 metre
Handle temperature rise test (< 40°C on plastic touch points)

standards.title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services – Part 1 Safety Requirements, Part 2 Performance Requirements
standards.description: Specifies safety and performance requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps with supply voltages up to 250 V AC 50 Hz, including luminous efficacy, color rendering, and lamp cap torque.
requirements: Insulation resistance and electric strength across cap pins and metal heatsink
Lamp cap mechanical torque strength (e.g. 3 Nm for B22d and E27 caps)
Resistance to heat and fire on thermoplastic housing (glow wire 650°C)
Fault condition safety: driver circuit must not ignite under component short
Luminous efficacy (minimum lumens per watt per BEE / BIS benchmarks)
Harmonic current distortion (THD < 15%) and power factor (> 0.90)
standards.scheme: Scheme II (Compulsory Registration Scheme - CRS) & Scheme I (ISI)
standards.qco_order: Electronics and IT Goods (Compulsory Registration) Order & BEE Star Rating
testing_parameters: Lamp cap torsion torque test with torque gauge
High voltage dielectric test at 1500 V AC
Luminous flux, CCT and CRI measurement in integrating sphere with spectroradiometer
Electrical harmonics and total harmonic distortion (THD) power analyzer test
Thermal endurance switching cycle test (15,000 on/off cycles)

standards.title: Household Frost-Free Refrigerating Appliances – Specification
standards.description: Specifies construction, refrigeration capacity, energy consumption and safety requirements for household frost-free and direct-cool refrigerators.
requirements: Electrical safety per IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 24) for hermetic compressor appliances
Flammable refrigerant (R600a / Isobutane) leak tightness and non-sparking electrical controls
Freezer compartment storage temperature performance (-18°C or below in 4-star compartment)
Daily and annual energy consumption test per BEE star labelling rules
Door gasket magnetic sealing effectiveness and pull force limits
Condenser heat dissipation and high ambient pulling-down test at 43°C
standards.scheme: Scheme I (ISI Mark Scheme) & BEE Mandatory Star Rating
standards.qco_order: BEE Mandatory Energy Rating & Refrigerating Appliances Safety Standard
testing_parameters: Energy consumption test in controlled psychrometric climate chamber at 32°C
Pull-down cooling speed test from 43°C ambient
Refrigerant circuit helium leak detection test (< 0.5 g/year)
Dielectric test at 1250 V AC on hermetic motor compressor
Door seal airtightness and thermal condensation test

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances – Part 2 Particular Requirements – Section 7 Washing Machines
standards.description: Covers safety requirements for electric washing machines intended for household laundry with centrifugal spin extractors.
requirements: Spin basket lid interlock braking mechanism (drum must stop within 10 seconds of opening)
Moisture and water splash ingress protection (IPX4 rating for outdoor/bathroom installation)
Drain pump and water valve electrical insulation under wet environments
Mechanical stability and vibration resistance during maximum spin speed (up to 1400 RPM)
Motor thermal protection and earth bonding continuity (< 0.1 ohm)
Internal water piping burst pressure safety against supply surges
standards.scheme: Scheme I (ISI Mark Scheme) & BEE Star Rating
standards.qco_order: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Spin tub brake time test after lid lifting
Water spray splash test per IPX4 specification
High voltage dielectric test at 1500 V AC
Unbalanced spin load test with off-center wet laundry weight
Continuous 100-cycle washing and rinsing endurance test

standards.title: Room Air Conditioners – Part 1 Unitary (Window) Air Conditioners, Part 2 Split Air Conditioners
standards.description: Specifies construction, cooling capacity, Indian Seasonal Energy Efficiency Ratio (ISEER), noise level and safety requirements for unitary and split air conditioners.
requirements: Cooling capacity and sensible heat ratio per psychrometric calorimeter chamber testing
ISEER (energy efficiency) rating compliance per BEE star labelling regulations
Refrigerant leak safety (R32 / R410A / R290 flammability and pressure safety)
Electrical insulation, outdoor unit weatherproofing (IPX4) and earthing
Maximum operating condition test at 46°C outdoor ambient without compressor trip
Condensate disposal and overflow freeze-up protection
standards.scheme: Scheme I (ISI Mark Scheme) & BEE Mandatory Star Rating
standards.qco_order: Air Conditioners and its Related Parts (Quality Control) Order, 2023 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Balanced ambient calorimeter chamber cooling capacity test
ISEER energy factor determination per IS 1391 Part 2
Maximum operating condition test at 46°C / 50°C ambient
Outdoor unit water rain ingress test per IPX4
High voltage test at 1500 V AC on hermetic compressor

standards.title: Drinking Water – Specification
standards.description: Prescribes requirements, acceptable limits and permissible limits in the absence of an alternate source for physical, chemical, toxic and bacteriological parameters of drinking water.
requirements: Organoleptic parameters: pH (6.5 to 8.5), Turbidity (< 1 NTU), Total Dissolved Solids (< 500 mg/l)
General contaminants: Hardness (< 200 mg/l), Chloride (< 250 mg/l), Sulphate (< 200 mg/l), Nitrate (< 45 mg/l)
Toxic heavy metals: Lead (< 0.01 mg/l), Arsenic (< 0.01 mg/l), Mercury (< 0.001 mg/l), Cadmium (< 0.003 mg/l)
Pesticide residues: total pesticides not exceeding 0.0005 mg/l
Bacteriological safety: E. coli and total coliform bacteria must be zero in any 100 ml sample
Virological and radiological limits per Atomic Energy Regulatory Board standards
standards.scheme: Scheme I (ISI Mark Scheme for commercial purifiers/water)
standards.qco_order: Indian Standard for Municipal and Public Water Supplies (Voluntary benchmark; Packaged Water is Mandatory under IS 14543)
testing_parameters: Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (ICP-MS) for heavy metals
Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) for pesticide residues
Membrane filtration technique for E. coli count
Turbidity meter nephelometric measurement
UV-Vis spectrophotometer for nitrate, fluoride and iron

standards.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) – Specification
standards.description: Specifies mandatory requirements, microbiological limits, purification treatments and packaging criteria for packaged drinking water sold in sealed plastic bottles, pouches and bulk containers.
requirements: Processing requirements: filtration, demineralisation, reverse osmosis and mandatory disinfection (ozonation / UV)
Microbiological limits: complete absence of Coliforms, E. coli, Faecal streptococci, Pseudomonas aeruginosa
Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) maintained between 75 mg/l and 500 mg/l
Packaging containers food-grade PET / Polycarbonate conforming to IS 15410 with tamper-proof seal
Shelf life declaration and batch printing with mandatory ISI mark on every bottle cap and label
Periodic daily in-house laboratory testing of raw and treated water
standards.qco_order: Food Safety and Standards Act (FSSAI) & BIS Mandatory Certification Order
testing_parameters: Membrane filtration microbiological testing for Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Coliforms
TDS gravimetric determination at 180°C
Barium, Copper, Iron, Lead, and Arsenic testing by ICP-MS
Pesticide residue testing by GC-MS/MS and LC-MS/MS
Bottle drop impact test and migration test per IS 9845

standards.title: Safety of Toys – Part 1 Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
standards.description: Specifies acceptable criteria for the physical and mechanical properties of toys for children up to 14 years, including small parts hazard, sharp edges, cords, and stability.
requirements: Small parts cylinder test: no component of toys for children under 36 months may fit in cylinder (choking hazard)
Accessible sharp edges and sharp points testing before and after abuse drop/torque tests
Cords and elastics length restrictions (< 220 mm) to prevent strangulation
Heavy metal chemical migration limits per IS 9873 (Part 3) (Lead < 90 mg/kg, Cadmium < 75 mg/kg)
Phthalate plasticizer content limit (max 0.1% for DEHP, DBP, BBP)
Non-flammability and burning rate limits per IS 9873 (Part 2)
standards.qco_order: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (DPIIT)
testing_parameters: Small parts cylinder test per IS 9873 Part 1 Clause 5.2
Sharp point tester and sharp edge tester following 5 drops from 850mm
Tensile pull test with 90 N force on seams and attachments
ICP-OES test for 8 heavy elements migration per IS 9873 Part 3
Gas chromatography testing for phthalate plasticizers

standards.title: Metallic Materials – Tensile Testing at Ambient Temperature
standards.description: Specifies method for tensile testing of metallic materials at ambient temperature (10°C to 35°C) to determine yield strength, tensile strength, percentage elongation and reduction of area.
requirements: Test specimen preparation dimensions per standard gauge length (5.65 * sqrt(So))
Strain rate control during elastic and plastic deformation stages
Determination of proof stress (non-proportional elongation Rp0.2)
Yield strength (upper and lower yield strength ReH, ReL)
Ultimate tensile strength (Rm) and percentage elongation after fracture
Calibrated testing machine accuracy class 1 or better per IS 1828
